C.title: Dog Vest with Teddy-Fleece Style Lining, Beige or Green
C.seoTitle: Dog Vest, Beige or Green, XS to 2XL | Drapewell
C.seoDescription: Casual dog vest in beige or green with a teddy-fleece style lining and twill outer. Sizes XS to 2XL, with a supplier size guide for small dogs.
C.descriptionHtml:
A casual dog vest in beige or green, with a teddy-fleece style lining and a twill outer, in sizes XS to 2XL.

  • Colours: beige or green
  • Fabric: teddy-fleece style lining with a twill outer
  • Casual style
  • Sizes XS, S, M, L, XL and 2XL
  • Included: 1 dog vest

Supplier size guide (cm)

Size Bust Back length Recommended dog weight
XS 32 20 1-3 kg
S 37 25 3-5 kg
M 42 30 5-8 kg
L 47 35 8-11 kg
XL 52 38 11-15 kg
2XL 57 42 15-20 kg

Weight bands are the supplier's recommendation. Measure your dog and compare with the table before ordering.

Ships with tracking from our supplier. Estimated delivery is 13-25 days to Canada and 10-20 days to the US, counted from the order date. Taxes are extra and shipping is calculated by weight at checkout.
